hypotheses.T0_conditional_coverage: At least 20 labels have 500 or more held-out positive-negative pairs sharing the exact same current token.
hypotheses.T1_model_behavior_uses_context: Among conditionally eligible labels, the model's median within-current-token output-logit AUROC is at least 0.60.
hypotheses.T2_layer1_coalitions_encode_context: Layer-1 rank-64 coalitions have median within-current-token AUROC at least 0.60 on conditionally competent labels.
hypotheses.T3_layer1_approaches_model_behavior: Layer-1 rank-256 conditional AUROC is within 0.05 of the model-output conditional AUROC median.
hypotheses.T4_depth_improves_conditional_code: Layer 1 exceeds layer 0 by at least 0.02 median conditional AUROC at rank 64.
hypotheses.T5_conditional_code_is_not_single_neuron: Rank-64 exceeds the best single native neuron by at least 0.05 median conditional AUROC in layer 1.
hypotheses.T6_exact_token_matching_removes_embeddin: Every scored positive-negative comparison shares the exact current token, so any deterministic isolated-token or embedding-only score has AUROC 0.5.
